    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Input must be numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input must be 2D matrix")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All values must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("All values must be nonpositive")
    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw = np.maximum(0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    w = raw / raw.sum()
    # Compute weighted losses: negative weighted sum of log probabilities
    L_plus = -np.sum(w * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(w * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(w * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (minimum of L_empty and L_call_only)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    # Margin and keep condition
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return (keep, margin)"}
